name: Voxcribe
tagline: Transcribe audio and video in your browser
description: Voxcribe transcribes video and audio in your browser. The video stays on your device; only its audio is uploaded. Edit timestamped transcripts while listening. TXT export is free; SRT, VTT, and DOCX exports are paid. The first anonymous file is free up to 10 minutes, and free accounts get 120 minutes per month. Audio is deleted after 7 days; unclaimed anonymous transcript text after 7 days; free-account text after 30 days; paid-plan text until deleted.
